title: Panzanella with {p}
steps: Cube the {s}, toss with a little oil and toast in a hot oven or pan until crisp at the edges.
Chop the {v} and toss with the {sauce} and the {spice}. Leave to sit 10 minutes so the juices soak in.
Cook the {p} until {doneness}. Canned beans or fish just need draining.
Toss in the toasted {s} just before serving to keep some crunch, and top with the {p}.
tip: Go heavy on tomato and cucumber, light on the oil, and use beans for protein and fiber.
